title: The Disclosure Protocol
description: A separate operation in three chapters. Fixed loadouts, explicit objectives and an isolated research budget.

ui.chapterFailed: CONTRACT EXPIRED / the objective was not demonstrated in time.
ui.upgradeDescription: Each rank installs one operation-only power: Might, Integrity, Growth, Armor, then Automation.
ui.ascensionDescription: Restart these chapters with an additional operation-only Might rank. Chapter progress, budget and purchased ranks reset; previous first-clear portfolio bounties stay claimed.

chapters.name: Initial Foothold
chapters.description: Enumerate the attack surface with a constrained arsenal. Demonstrate enough impact to open the next scope.

chapters.name: Weaponize the Primitive
chapters.description: Read the forbidden source and turn small primitives into a working build. Your budget belongs to this operation.

chapters.name: Coordinated Disclosure
chapters.description: Prove the chain against a privileged process, recover the source relic and leave with reproducible evidence.
chapters.objectiveText: Recover the stage relic and defeat a boss.
